scope: Independent full CLOSED confirmation instrumentation, original fields and opaque byte binding only. No provider/model/test/analyzer/oracle execution, source/control change, rescoring, or favorable-window filtering.

admission.noReplacementOrAutomaticEvaluatorRerun: Exact frozen schedule, unique identity index, original ordered lifecycle rows and one parent spawn each verified; original runner/analyzer receipts explicitly report no restart/rerun. Legitimate runtime requests within an original arm are retained.

transport.perResponseLimit: Positive and bounded by min(4096, remaining reported-generated allowance of 12000).
transport.qualification: Proxy-facing 502 is not evidence of provider HTTP 502. All 716 actual response records are HTTP 200 and report the exact model; twenty transport-error requests have no response and retain unknown reported identity/counters. No recorded 401/403 establishes an authentication failure. Reported model metadata is not independent certification of backend model internals.

attributionQualification: All 108 parent-assigned state identities/receipts are bound, but only 104 native outputs report a matching identity. Four missing native observations stay unavailable. The original zero-request Hermes code_fix-v1-r1 budget failure has two queue arrivals rejected before upstream forwarding, known zero final counters and no usage journal; it is not an unknown-usage arm. Directory existence or a parent index never fills native identity.
failureQualification: Ten accounting-uncertain and one known-zero budget-failed arm remain original primary failures. Seven other unsuccessful arms completed natively and retain their original task/oracle failures. Semantic DOCX diagnosis is outside this review; structural validity does not certify every oracle as a complete measure of practical task quality.
resourceQualification: Atlas known-arm subtotals: 1949084 prompt / 135396 generated; observed counters including partial arms: 2012853 / 139063 across 335 request records. Hermes known-arm subtotals: 2550712 / 87525; observed counters including partial arms: 2587187 / 89945 across 401 records. Complete totals remain unknown for both (A6/H4 unknown arms). Known zero is retained as zero; missing totals are not zero. Cost remains unknown for both and counters do not certify billing.

clockAndHealth.interpretation: Original caller wall-minus-monotonic gaps are about78.779/942.609/909.701/677.696/349.615 seconds. Matching five OS entry/wake category intervals supports host suspension, not a universal or request-level transport cause. Entry/wake includes transition time. No timestamp, denominator, failure, budget or score is corrected; no favorable-window subset is substituted.
clockAndHealth.osEvidenceLimit: Reverified closed filtered OS category projection and original clock/ledger metadata; did not rerun OS query. Raw OS strings were discarded by the owner; captured-byte hash is a binding, not an independently available raw log. Entry/wake categories include transition time and cannot identify exact request-level failure cause.
clockAndHealth.scopeLimit: Validity here means the registered original evidence supports attribution and source/transport accounting, not that every attempt finished within300 wall-clock seconds or ran under continuously awake healthy-host conditions.

cleanupAndDeadlineLimits: All direct child close/exit observations and complete parent receipts are retained. allDescendantsGone remains unproved; process-group absence at probe is not universal descendant termination.

The caller deadline covers full await invoke including internal reference/compatibility persistence. Later caller-receipt persistence, broker finalization and private grading are not a hard whole-pipeline watchdog. Separately sampled process elapsed counters and observation timestamps are not forcibly equated.

finiteCensus.scope: Exact finite scheduled census, model and execution setup only; no inference to unseen tasks or providers.

decision.multiplicity: Fixed finite census; no statistical noninferiority or multiplicity-calibrated interval.
decision.statement: Descriptive complete-denominator counts only; finite-census equal-or-better prerequisites do not qualify.

claimInterpretation: The original complete finite census reports Atlas44/54 and Hermes46/54. Required gates were Atlas at least49/54, each family at least5/6 and Atlas count at least Hermes. The original analyzer reports ineligible; no equal-or-better claim is established. This is not a new score or a claim of Hermes population superiority; it does not generalize to other providers/subscriptions/tasks or establish causal C9 improvement.
reviewerCorrectionScope: Five reviewer-only assumptions/serialization mistakes are retained with original utilities and exact failure logs: separately sampled clock equality, parent/native directory equality, mandatory journal existence for zero requests, queue arrivals equated with upstream requests, Python None versus JSON null label. Corrected checks follow existing frozen schemas and preserve all raw fields. No source/control/score change or new experimental counterexample was executed.
independence: Reviewer did not author current caller/analyzer. Prior underlying authenticated HTTP guard/principal authorship and prior offline/development reviews are disclosed. This is independent current instrumentation inspection, not independent revalidation of authored guard design.
